---
title: "rodeo_explore"
format: html
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)

## top rider 2025
jose <- read_csv("phoebechar/rodeo/Jose_Vitor_Leme.csv")

jose <- jose |> mutate(date = ymd(date))

## rookie of the year 2025
hudson <- read_csv("phoebechar/rodeo/Hudson_Bolton.csv")

hudson <- hudson |> mutate(date = ymd(date))

ggplot(jose, aes(x = date, y = score)) +
  geom_point()

jose_noDQ <- jose |> filter(score != 0)

hudson_noDQ <- hudson |> filter(score != 0)

ggplot(jose_noDQ, aes(x = date, y = score)) +
  geom_point()

ggplot(jose_noDQ, aes(x = score)) +
  geom_histogram()

ggplot(hudson_noDQ, aes(x = score)) +
  geom_histogram()

jose <- jose |> mutate(rider = "Jose")

hudson <- hudson |> mutate(rider = "Hudson")

compare <- full_join(hudson, jose)

full_noDQ <- compare |> filter(score != 0)

ggplot(full_noDQ, aes(x = rider, group = rider, y = score)) +
  geom_boxplot()


ggplot(full_noDQ, aes(x = date, y = score)) +
  geom_point(aes(colour = rider))
```
